```{r Setup}
# load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(matchingR)

# set base folder
here::i_am("allocation_ba_round2.Rmd")

# Import utils and config
purrr::walk(
  list.files(here::here("utils"), pattern = "\\.R$", full.names = TRUE),
  source
)

# Config
# Input Paths
student_preferences_ba_round2_path <- "input/student_preferences_ba_round2.txt"
supervisor_preferences_ba_path <- "input/supervisor_preferences_ba.txt"

# Output Paths
allocations_ba_round2_path <- "output/allocations_ba_round2.csv"
unassigned_ba_round2_path <- "output/unassigned_ba_round2.csv"
```

# Safely load data
```{r}
# Student preferences
student_preferences_ba_round2 <- load_student_preferences(
  file_path = here(student_preferences_ba_round2_path)
  )

print(student_preferences_ba_round2)
```


```{r}
# Supervisor/Topic preferences

supervisor_preferences_ba <- load_supervisor_preferences(
  file_path = here(supervisor_preferences_ba_path),
  implicit_capacity_1 = TRUE
)
print(supervisor_preferences_ba)
```


# Check Data Validity
```{r}
# Cross validate Student and Supervisor Preferences
crossvalidate_preferences(student_preferences_ba_round2, supervisor_preferences_ba)
```

# Allocate Students by Supervisor-Proposing Deferred Acceptance

```{r}
allocation_output_ba_round2 <- allocate_by_da(
  student_prefs = student_preferences_ba_round2, 
  supervisor_prefs = supervisor_preferences_ba
)
```

```{r}
#matches
allocations_ba_round2 <- allocation_output_ba_round2$matches
print(allocations_ba_round2)
```

```{r}
# unassigned students/topics
unassigned_ba_round2 <- allocation_output_ba_round2$unassigned

print(unassigned_ba_round2)
```

# Write output

```{r}
write_csv(allocations_ba_round2, here(allocations_ba_round2_path))
write_csv(unassigned_ba_round2, here(unassigned_ba_round2_path))
```
